prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1481; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on the access road in Sugar Land, Texas, when the car behind me struck the rear of my vehicle. The impact was firm enough to push me forward against my seatbelt, and I felt an immediate stiffness in my neck that grew worse over the next hour. I exchanged information with the other driver at the scene and gave the same description of what happened to the officer, to the adjuster who called me, and to the medical staff who examined me. I am the named driver on this policy and was operating the insured vehicle with the owner's permission. I have since been treated for a neck strain and have followed the recommended course of rest, medication, and physical therapy. I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed with my account on record.
